statement: There are arbitrarily small fixed u > 0 and then 0 < w < u/10000 for which the following statements hold. Use the nested partitions fixed in (2.9), with B ≍ Du, R ≍ Dw, and d = 1/j. For every normalized nonnegative bosonic ground vector, 1 |CR| X A∈CR E(qA − 1)2 ≤ CD−1−w/6 , (4.1) 1 |Cd| X A∈Cd E(qA − 1)4 ≤ CjD−1−u/6 . (4.2) For every normalized, possibly complex, bosonic ground vector, 1 V * N X i=1 WR,i + = 8 3 √ π α3/2 + o(1), (4.3) 1 V * N X i=1 Wd,i + ≤ ϵj + oj(1), ϵj −→ 0 (j −→ ∞). (4.4) Here the thermodynamic limit is taken first, at fixed dilution; the remainders then tend to zero as D → ∞, and oj(1) has this meaning with j fixed. The bounds are uniform over the indicated ground vectors and along every density-convergent thermodynamic sequence. A sufficiently large volume threshold may depend on the dilution and on j.
